proposals.title: OCC, Comptroller's Handbook — Commercial Loans (Section 206): narrative March 1990, procedures March 1998
proposals.use: Historical US methodological context for borrower financial/cash analysis, primary repayment sources, term-loan amortization, collateral realizability and documented monitoring. Original case, thresholds, priority assumptions and proofs are not attributed to the source.
proposals.verification: Actual official 30-page PDF body opened. Cover dates and March20,2025 reputation-risk-reference removal notice inspected. Read printed pages14–16 (PDF pages16–18) for financial/commitment, cash-service, repayment and collateral analysis, and printed page20 (PDF page22) for covenants, information and collateral controls. No claim of whole-booklet or current legal completeness.
proposals.scope_limits: Historical numerical/regulatory definitions, legal citations, current supervisory requirements, observed defaults and empirical recovery estimates are not imported. The teaching waterfall is stipulated, not a jurisdictional priority opinion.

original_material: All Morrow contracts, scenarios, numerical values, probability weights, policy thresholds, cash-feasibility/waterfall derivations, finite incentive examples, exercises and implementation are original. Prior accepted accounting, finite expectation and dated valuation methods are reused within their taught scope.
